xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3194: Resume probes trust stored sessionId without verifying the transcript exists — missing JSONL crash-loops agents into troubled

plan.title: Resume probes trust stored sessionId without verifying the transcript exists — missing JSONL crash-loops agents into troubled
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: Resume probes (pan start's fresh-refusal, the /has-session route + stopped-agent listing, and the deacon auto-resume spawn decision) infer resumability from the presence of a stored sessionId and never verify the Claude JSONL transcript exists at sessionFilePath(workspace, sessionId). agent-pan-2876 crash-looped 3x into troubled: transcript resolution logged reason=jsonl-missing at every patrol while pan start refused fresh-less starts and auto-resume attempted --resume against the missing transcript, dying before kickoff delivery each time. PAN-2895 added an in-resumeAgent missing-transcript recovery (fresh-launch + pointer clearing) but it has no test coverage, the probe-level lie is unfixed, and the incident build's live dashboard predated even that recovery.
narratives.Proposal: Introduce one shared predicate claudeSessionTranscriptExists(cwd, sessionId) in src/lib/paths.ts and use it at every probe point: (1) work-agent-lifecycle.ts sync + async snapshots compute an additive hasResumableTranscript flag (claude-code/unset harness only) so a missing transcript yields recommendedAction 'start', canStartFresh true, canResumeSession false — pan start proceeds fresh without --fresh; (2) buildStoppedAgentLifecycle in the dashboard listing applies the same probe; (3) the spawn-mode decision in resume.ts is extracted behavior-preservingly into a pure decideResumeSpawnPlan module with unit tests locking the missing-transcript → fresh-launch + pointer-clearing path so no launch crash can accrue to the troubled counter; (4) docs/AGENT-STATE-PLANES.md documents transcript-verified resumability. Probes stay read-only; clearAgentSessionPointers in resumeAgent remains the only mutation point. PAN-1980 rotation refusal semantics are preserved (drift + missing transcript still refuses).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing PAN-1980 session-rotation refusal semantics: model/harness drift combined with a missing transcript still refuses and leaves the agent stopped for an operator decision.
- Transcript verification for codex, ohmypi, or acp resume targets (codex/ohmypi already resolve ids from on-disk artifacts; acp is a follow-up).
- Clearing or mutating session.id / sessions.json / runtime.json from any read path (lifecycle resolvers, listing builders, routes).
- Deploying the dashboard build — the DoD deploy row owns getting the merged fix onto the live server (see hazard H1).
- Reworking the async Effect getLatestSessionId resolver (activity.ts:220) to add the codex/acp/ohmypi branches the sync variant has.

autoDecisions.summary: Missing transcript routes to fresh-spawn without clearing pointers on read (issue offered 'fresh-spawn OR mark stale and clear')
autoDecisions.rationale: Read doors must not write; resumeAgent's existing clearAgentSessionPointers is the single mutation point and a fresh spawn overwrites session.id anyway, so read-path clearing adds risk with no benefit.

autoDecisions.summary: Transcript probe applies only to claude-code/unset harness
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue is Claude-JSONL-specific; codex thread ids and ohmypi session ids are already resolved from on-disk artifacts, and checking them against a Claude JSONL path would false-negative every stopped non-Claude agent.

autoDecisions.summary: Drift + missing transcript keeps the PAN-1980 rotation refusal
autoDecisions.rationale: The refusal is a deliberate operator checkpoint protecting against silent session rotation; the incident shape (plain resume, no drift) is fully covered without widening recovery semantics.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-3 regression lock uses a new pure decideResumeSpawnPlan module rather than a full resumeAgent mock harness
autoDecisions.rationale: resumeAgent's ~25-import dependency surface is always wholesale-mocked in existing tests; a behavior-preserving pure extraction gives the same decision coverage without fragility, matching the repo's split-pure-logic pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: hasSavedSession semantics unchanged; new additive hasResumableTranscript field on WorkAgentLifecycleState
autoDecisions.rationale: The no-loss rule: dashboard hasSession, dispatch-gate, unpause, and listing consumers keep their current contract while the probe result is available for future surfaces.

Extract decideResumeSpawnPlan pure module from resume.ts and lock the missing-transcript fresh-launch path

expected_outputs: pure decider tests pass for all five spawn-plan cases

narrative.Action: resumeAgent has no direct unit tests (its ~25-import surface is always mocked wholesale, e.g. message-agent-interventions.test.ts:74). Lock FR-3 by extracting the decision at src/lib/agents/resume.ts:337-395 into a new pure module src/lib/agents/resume-spawn-plan.ts exporting `decideResumeSpawnPlan(input: ResumeSpawnPlanInput): ResumeSpawnPlan` with input { harness, compactSeed: boolean, driftReasons: string[], piProcessWasAlive: boolean, transcriptExists: boolean, allowExplicitRecovery: boolean } and output { mode: 'resume-saved' | 'fresh', freshReason?: 'compact' | 'drift' | 'pi-dead-recovery' | 'claude-jsonl-missing', clearSessionPointers: boolean, rotationRefused: boolean }. Preserve exact current precedence: compact → PAN-1980 rotation refusal (drift) → pi-dead-recovery → claude-jsonl-missing (clearSessionPointers true only here) → resume-saved; keep sessionRotationRefused semantics including allowExplicitRecovery, and keep the drift+missing refusal (decision D3). resume.ts calls the decider and keeps ALL side effects (logging, clearAgentSessionPointers, saveSessionId, launcher build) in place. Write src/lib/agents/__tests__/resume-spawn-plan.test.ts with no mocks covering the five cases.

items.title: Given claude-code harness, no compact seed, no drift reasons, and transcriptExists false, decideResumeSpawnPlan returns mode 'fresh', freshReason 'claude-jsonl-missing', clearSessionPointers true, rotationRefused false — so no --resume launch is attempted and no launch-crash failure can accrue to the troubled counter
Given claude-code harness, no compact seed, no drift reasons, and transcriptExists true, decideResumeSpawnPlan returns mode 'resume-saved'
Given non-empty driftReasons with transcriptExists true (and with transcriptExists false), decideResumeSpawnPlan returns rotationRefused true (PAN-1980 semantics preserved)

Given compactSeed true, decideResumeSpawnPlan returns mode 'fresh' with freshReason 'compact'; given ohmypi harness with piProcessWasAlive false and no drift/compact, it returns mode 'fresh' with freshReason 'pi-dead-recovery'

resume.ts imports and calls decideResumeSpawnPlan from resume-spawn-plan.ts, npm run typecheck completes without errors, and npx vitest run src/lib/agents/__tests__/resume.test.ts exits 0 (behavior-preserving extraction)
